title: Fathom Pricing (2026): Plans, Costs & Hidden Fees
summary: Fathom pricing structures determine your monthly expenses based on the total number of administrative seats assigned within your organization.
body_markdown:
## Feature breakdown across Fathom subscription levels


The decision to upgrade from the Fathom free tier is driven by the need for centralized data governance and the removal of manual entry between the meeting recorder and the system of record.


While your individual experience remains functional at no cost, the platform gates the utility of historical data and automated workflows behind its paid tiers to capture value from your growing team.


### Fathom AI summaries and search features by plan


Fathom provides automated transcription and basic summaries on all tiers, but you'll have to transition to a paid plan to unlock the full utility of its advanced intelligence. The free tier uses a standard summary format.


Unlimited Advanced AI Summaries are provided in the Premium and Team plans. These allow you to customize the output structure to match your specific internal reporting styles.


A ten-step process to clean and route these summaries costs the same to run as a simple two-step notification.


Activepieces bills 1 credit per flow run regardless of the number of steps, as shown on its published pricing page, which removes the cost penalty for building more granular and reliable data pipelines.


This allows teams to break complex meeting follow-ups into smaller, verifiable stages without increasing their automation bill.


This ensures that you can extract action items in a format that maps directly to your task tracker without manual reformatting. Across the entire meeting library, Fathom restricts advanced search capabilities to paid users.


You can only query the collective knowledge of all staff meetings once you've moved off the free version.


### CRM integrations and automated data entry


When manual data entry becomes the primary friction point, it forces a shift to the Team plan. The free version allows for basic recording, but the ability to sync meeting highlights and summaries directly into a customer relationship management (CRM) platform is a paid feature.


Through this automation, a sales representative’s notes become instantly visible to the rest of your organization within the account record. The following triggers represent the point where manual copy-pasting becomes a liability:


- CRM Sync (Salesforce/HubSpot)
- Unlimited Advanced AI Summaries
- Team Folders for shared access


These features are what turn a personal productivity tool into a shared asset. They ensure that no verbal commitment made during a call is lost due to administrative oversight.


### Security, privacy, and administrative controls


Regardless of feature usage, organizational requirements for data handling and user management often mandate an upgrade. As your company grows, the need for a SOC2 Compliance report is a prerequisite for legal clearance.


Fathom provides this document for its enterprise-level engagements. Security is further tightened through Single Sign-On (SSO) and Centralized Billing.


This allows you to provision or revoke access from a single dashboard rather than managing individual expense reports. These controls ensure that sensitive meeting recordings remain within your company's domain even after an employee departs.
